name: Duskline Apparel Messenger Sling Bag
description:
A compact, cross-body sling bag with a signal-shielded interior compartment and quick-access exterior pockets. The main compartment is lined with Faraday mesh that blocks all wireless signals to and from whatever is stored inside — useful for carrying devices you don't want tracked or data cores you don't want remotely wiped.

The bag's exterior is unremarkable urban grey. The shoulder strap is reinforced with a steel cable core that resists cutting. A common sight in courier and runner circles where the contents of the bag are more valuable than the person carrying it.
functionality: Signal-shielded storage, cut-resistant strap, quick-access pockets
what_it_says: Whatever you're carrying is invisible to every scanner on the street until you decide to take it out.
story_hooks: A courier's sling bag is recovered with the Faraday compartment intact — but the data core inside was remotely wiped anyway, meaning someone breached the shielding without opening the bag.
